sources.fullCitation: The Jack Hylton Orchestra, directed by Jack Hylton, with Jack Jackson, Philippe Brun and Leo Vauchant. “Herr Lehmann, Herr Lehmann, Was Macht Die Frau Gemahlin In Marienbad?” On “Hot Hylton” 1926–1930, Challenge Records International, ℗ 2000, released 1 January 2000; art track supplied to YouTube by The Orchard Enterprises and published on the auto-generated artist channel on 10 February 2015. media.title: Herr Lehmann, Herr Lehmann — Jack Hylton, listening reference
media.description: Recording of “Herr Lehmann, Herr Lehmann, was macht die Frau Gemahlin in Marienbad?” by the Jack Hylton Orchestra, reissued by Challenge Records and linked as an external listening reference.
media.altText: Listening reference for “Herr Lehmann, Herr Lehmann, was macht die Frau Gemahlin in Marienbad?”.
media.rightsNote: The recording is not rehosted: the link points to the rights holder's own upload. The transfer carries a 2000 phonogram claim by Challenge Records International over a recording made between 1926 and 1930; reuse of the transfer would need their permission, and the status of the original recording is not established here.
media.publicCaption: Listening reference for “Herr Lehmann, Herr Lehmann, was macht die Frau Gemahlin in Marienbad?” in the recording by the Jack Hylton Orchestra, from the compilation “Hot Hylton” 1926–1930 supplied to YouTube by The Orchard Enterprises. The reissue does not identify the original disc; this is an access copy, not rights evidence.
